name: CardStack
whenToUse: A landing or empty-state showcase that cycles a few cards: testimonials, highlights, recent invoices.

whenNotToUse.text: Content the user has to read or act on

anatomy.description: the front card plus `depth` cards behind it, each 12px higher and 5% smaller.
every `interval` ms the front card drops away and returns to the back.
Pause / Play and Next, under the deck.

do.caption: Few short cards; time to read each one.

dont.caption: Interactive content that leaves while someone is using it.

a11y: Pauses on hover and while anything inside has focus; Pause / Play stops it for good (WCAG 2.2.2).
Only the front card is in the accessibility tree; the rest are aria-hidden and inert.
prefers-reduced-motion: no timer and no animation, the cards change only with Next.

props.name: depth
props.description: Cards visible behind the front one (default 2).

props.name: hideControls
props.description: Hide the Pause / Next controls — only when the page has another way to stop it.

props.name: interval
props.description: Time each card stays in front, ms (default 4000).

props.name: layout
props.description: `stack`: cards behind sit higher and smaller. `fan`: they spread to the side like a hand of cards.
